differences: Shell fur is left out: glTF has no shells, so the coat is not drawn; the skin's maps carry its mean colour and roughness, and the engine's own fur should be driven from extras.fur
Light wrapping round the skin is left out: the engine shows a harder edge between light and shadow
Breathing (a 1% swell of the chest while idle) is left out
Fine pattern detail is baked at the texel's size, where the live skin fades it with distance; mipmaps fade it further away
